name: Weathervane
tagline: A die names the trump every trick; no suit to follow, only choices.
core_loop: The trick winner rolls one die to set trump (or Calm, or a doubling Gale), then leads or passes the lead; everyone plays any card, and the winner scores one point per card plus one per trump immediately.
win_condition: Most points after every hand is empty; ties break on tricks won, then latest trick won.
